QUOTE: Callbacks | Pointers are valid only during the call. Do not re-enter the API from a callback. Exceptions must not escape. ... `hooks.py` catches all exceptions.

WHY: The answer states hooks.py catches all exceptions so none escape into the engine. It doesn't say a failed hook is treated as a pass-through, but the item's central mechanism of swallowing every exception is stated.
